notes.title: Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory arrives on Steam as a free update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31247536/13ee32b054823ec539e69703cd383d6189a04f51.png

Bringing Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory to Steam was a bigger challenge than we anticipated. Rise to Glory uses a different codebase than Fallen Legion+ and integrating the extra content led to bugs. We were determined to do it and the sole programmer that built Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory for Nintendo Switch rebuilt the game for PC.

If you have Fallen Legion+, you also have Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory! If you want to play the original release, Fallen Legion+, please go to the directory where the game is installed and run fallenlegion.exe. The update adds fallenlegion-rtg.exe which plays Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory. Unfortunately, save data is incompatible between the two versions.

Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory has:
-	Five bonus playable characters including the elusive Succubus pictured here.
-	Face the Alarune, Prince Thuradal and Ignis in new boss battles.
-	More levels and story branches.
-	A Japanese voiceover option starring Shizuka Ishikami as Cecille, Hidenori Takahashi as the Legate, Kengo Kawanishi as the Grimoire, Ai Kakuma as Antoinette and Shinya Fukumatsu as Maurice.
-	English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese language options.

[previewyoutube=uuTodzRSKKg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy finding Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory’s secret characters and new story routes!
